title: Add GLN information to XRechnung and ZUGFeRD exports
summary: GLN identifiers with schemeID 0088 are now included in German XRechnung and ZUGFeRD electronic document exports, respecting customer GLN settings and address hierarchy rules.
key_points: GLNs emitted with schemeID='0088' in XRechnung supplier, customer, and delivery identifiers
Customer 'Use GLN in Electronic Document' setting is respected for XRechnung customer GLNs
Delivery GLNs resolved from ship-to address first, then fallback to sell-to customer if opted-in
ZUGFeRD documents now include buyer and ship-to GLNs with schemeID='0088'
Test coverage added for supplier, customer, and address precedence scenarios
quote: Adds GLN information to the German XRechnung and ZUGFeRD exports, aligning their identifier handling with the existing electronic-document setup.
